notes.title: 🧹 One Man’s Trash - Game Modes Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"][/img]🚨 [b]Spoiler Warning:[/b][/p][p]This post reveals gameplay systems, item mechanics, and late-game content. Prefer to discover things yourself? Now’s the time to stop scrolling.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 New Difficulty Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]🛋 Cozy Mode[/b]
A relaxed experience:
• No enemies
• Coupons never expire — use them anytime
• Perfect for chill diggers and explorers[/p][p][/p][p][b]🧹 Classic Mode[/b] [i](Default)[/i]
The tried-and-true setup:
• Enemies spawn deep underground
• Coupons expire shortly after pickup
• Balanced and faithful to the core experience[/p][p][/p][p][b]🕳 Abyss Mode[/b]
For the brave (or foolish):
• No central rope — escape is up to you
• Enemies hit harder
• Coupons can be stored like in Cozy
• A true descent into madness[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Pet Worm Overhaul[/h3][p]Your loyal worm now [b]consumes trash from your vacuum’s dustbag[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🏆 New Achievement[/h3][p][b]💀 No Way Up[/b]
Complete a full run in Abyss Mode.
Only the toughest (or most stubborn) diggers will make it out alive.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][p]• Minor bug fixes[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Dig deep. Stay sharp. Feed the worm.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Tag us on socials or join the community:[/b] 
👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/fCR7a99yWG"]Join the Discord[/url] – share finds, bugs, screenshots, memes, and your wildest holes.
[b]
Jony Pazu[/b]
[i]Solo Dev[/i][/p]

[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598516/2b5e9a2d05851af34e6052a68b972266542b3ff1.png"][/img][/h2][h3]🚨 Spoiler Warning:[/h3][p]This post contains a [b]full breakdown of all core gameplay systems, upgrades, item types, and end-game goals[/b]. If you're someone who likes to discover everything on your own  feel free to stop scrolling now and go dig.[/p][p]For everyone else: here's exactly what awaits you in [b]One Man’s Trash[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Also: Join the official [b]JONY PAZU GAMES[/b] Discord:[/h3][p]👉 [url="https://discord.com/invite/fCR7a99yWG"]https://discord.com/invite/fCR7a99yWG[/url][/p][p]Why Join?[/p][p]• Share your [b]weirdest vacuum builds[/b]
• Post your [b]best finds & cursed screenshots[/b]
• Report [b]bugs[/b]
• And yes, show us your [b]messed-up pits[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🗑 ONE MANS TRASH – Complete Feature List[/h2][h3]🔧 Core Gameplay[/h3][p]• [b]Vacuum Tool:[/b] Suck up trash and materials to dig deeper
• [b]Rope System:[/b] Climb back up with a central rope
• [b]Progressive Digging:[/b] Dig your own way in an endless pit[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💻 Laptop Hub (3 Websites)[/h3][p]• [b]Junkbay:[/b] Sell your junk
• [b]Junkazon:[/b] Buy upgrades, tools, and utilities
• [b]Junkasino:[/b] Gamble your savings (it’s probably a bad idea)[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔼 Upgrade System[/h3][p]• [b]Vacuum Strength:[/b] More suction
• [b]Vacuum Size:[/b] Bigger area
• [b]Vacuum Capacity:[/b] Carry more per trip
• [b]Inventory Space:[/b] Bigger bag = better haul
• [b]Rope Length:[/b] Go deeper
• [b]One-Time Tools:[/b] Lamps & scanners[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🗑 Collectibles (62 Total)[/h3][p]• [b]Normal Trash (30):[/b] Cones, toilets, cardboard boxes, etc.
• [b]Rare Items (20):[/b] High-value collectibles (Einstein’s Brain, Moon pebble, and more)
• [b]Locations (12):[/b] Hidden spaces like trains, cars, mine shafts, even a spaceship[/p][p]• [b]Special Items:[/b][/p][p]   o Double jump
   o Shop discount timer
   o Other surprises[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 World & Secrets[/h3][p]• [b]Surface Junkyard:[/b] Full of stuff to vacuum
• [b]Underground World:[/b] More loot, more risk
• [b]Mine System:[/b] With TNT traps and... strange sounds
• [b]Deep Spaceship:[/b] Includes a teleporter[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📦 Collection & Progression[/h3][p]• [b]3 Trophy Containers:[/b] Track trash, rares, and locations
• [b]Pedestals:[/b] Display the cool stuff you found
• [b]Unlock Skins:[/b] For your vacuum
• [b]Achievements:[/b] 25 to complete[/p][hr][/hr][h3]☠ Enemies & Hazards[/h3][p]• [b]Worms:[/b] They’re real. They’re fast. They’re angry.
• [b]TNT Traps:[/b] Use them wisely[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎯 Main Goal[/h3][p]• [b]Find the Lost Hard Drive[/b]
It holds [b]7,000 PitCoin[/b]. It’s worth millions. It’s probably real. Maybe.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧃 That’s the Game.[/h2][p]A trash-filled descent. An addictive core loop. Secrets, satire, and suction.[/p][p]👉 [b]Join the Discord[/b] and let us know what you find.
👉 And if you haven’t yet – [b]wishlist the game[/b] to support the launch on [b]July 23[/b]![/p][p][b]Stay trashy,[/b]
– Jony Pazu 🧹[/p]

notes.title: 🚧 One Man’s Trash – Public Demo Updated & July Release Incoming!
notes.content:
Big things are happening in the junkyard! The [b]public demo[/b] of [b]One Man’s Trash[/b] just received a major update – with more to explore, new systems to uncover, and your first glimpse of what’s coming in the full game.
📆 Full release planned for [b]July 2025[/b]
 🧡 Wishlist now to support the launch and stay in the loop!

🔧 What’s New in the Demo:
🗂️ [b]Collection System[/b]
 Rare items now glow and can be displayed in your Trophy Room. Discover hidden locations and build your collection!
🔒 [b]Locked Vitrines[/b]
 Find and unlock special vacuum skins by completing item and location sets.
📻 [b]Radio System[/b]
 You can now turn on the radio and switch between multiple music tracks – or turn it off if you prefer the silence.

🛠️ [b]Plus:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced item values & upgrade costs
[*] Improved overheating mechanics
[*] Carry two special items instead of one
[*] Added credits page
[*] Tons of bug fixes and polish
[/list]

Whether you're returning to the junkyard or diving in for the first time: now’s the perfect time to experience the updated demo – and get hyped for the full game in July!
👉 [b]Add One Man’s Trash to your wishlist now and don’t miss the release![/b]
